content.question: In supervised learning, what is the difference between regression and classification?
options: Regression predicts a continuous value, while classification predicts a discrete class label.
Regression works with unlabeled data, while classification requires labeled data.
Regression finds hidden clusters in the data, while classification learns from rewards and penalties.
Regression can only handle text data, while classification can only handle images.
content.answer: Regression predicts a continuous value, while classification predicts a discrete class label.
